book: Annales Clivię-Iuliæ-Montiæ Marchiæ, Ravensburgiæ antiquæ et modernæ (Arnhem 1638, Wernher Techenmacher): front matter (dedications, reader's address, syllabus of authors, portrait), then Pars Prima in three books on the peoples and early history, then Pars Secunda on the modern provinces in five membra, with appendices and the Geldrian material.
